# A. Digit Sum Range

## How to find it

Precompute suffix counts by length and sum, then scan each tight prefix.

## Correctness

Every smaller prefix digit is paired with all suffixes having the one required remaining sum; the bound itself is added exactly when its sum matches. Range subtraction leaves precisely the interval.

## Complexity

`O(19 * 171 * 10)` preprocessing and `O(19 * 10)` per bound.

# B. Forbidden Decimal Pattern

## How to find it

Take the product of digit-bound state and a KMP prefix automaton.

## Correctness

The KMP state exactly summarizes every suffix relevant to a future pattern occurrence; rejecting the terminal state is necessary and sufficient.

## Complexity

`O(19 * |P| * 10)` per query.

# C. Obstacle Domino Tilings

## How to find it

Scan the first uncovered cell under an incoming occupancy mask.

## Correctness

Every tiling covers that cell horizontally or vertically exactly once, and each legal transition preserves nonoverlap and complete coverage.

## Complexity

`O(n * 2^m * m)` up to transition constants.

# D. Grid Independent Sets

## How to find it

Enumerate horizontally valid row masks and reject overlap with blocked cells or the previous row.

## Correctness

These tests are exactly the horizontal and vertical adjacency constraints, so row induction is bijective.

## Complexity

`O(n * V^2)`, where `V` is the number of horizontally valid masks.
